description: Projets en développement en électricité renouvelable en Pays de la Loire (au 31 décembre 2021) is a dataset listed in data.teo-paysdelaloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by RTE, Enedis, Agence ORÉ. Ce jeu de données expose les projets (en MW) de raccordement en développement sur les réseaux de transport et de distribution en électricité au 31 décembre 2024. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are Filière, Projet de raccordement, TEO. The portal shows 9 records. The portal shows 2022-10-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-teo-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
